title: VP of Product Management

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: As a $241.8M wholesale distributor with 65+ locations carrying premium overlaminate films from 3M, Avery Dennison, RTape, and Orafol, the VP of Product Management owns portfolio strategy and vendor selection decisions. This role directly determines which protective film brands are added to Grimco's catalog and positioned to their sign shop, vehicle wrap, and graphics customers. Tedlar's 12-20+ year outdoor durability and graffiti resistance represent clear product differentiation opportunities that would enable Grimco to compete in the ultra-premium segment where they currently may lack offerings. This executive cares about: (1) margin opportunities from premium products, (2) portfolio gaps in extreme-durability overlaminates for outdoor/architectural applications, (3) competitive positioning against other distributors, and (4) vendor partnerships that enhance their market leadership (evidenced by 10 consecutive FASTSIGNS Vendor of the Year awards). Tedlar's 60+ year brand heritage and proven performance would strengthen Grimco's reputation as a premium supplier while addressing customer pain points around warranty claims and product longevity that impact distributor relationships.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: [Name] owns Grimco's product portfolio strategy across 65+ locations, deciding which protective film brands get added to their catalog alongside current suppliers 3M, Avery Dennison, RTape, and Orafol. This role has budget authority for new vendor partnerships and sets pricing/positioning strategy for overlaminate products sold to sign shops, vehicle wrap installers, and graphics companies. [Name] reports to C-suite (likely CEO/President) and manages product category managers responsible for digital media, overlaminates, and substrate segments. Key decisions include: vendor selection and contract negotiation, SKU rationalization across the national footprint, premium vs. value product mix, and go-to-market positioning for new product launches.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: Grimco's customers face real-world durability challenges where Tedlar solves specific problems: (1) Outdoor signage for retail, municipal, and commercial applications where UV degradation causes costly replacements—Tedlar's resistance to yellowing, fading, and cracking extends sign life 2-3x versus standard overlaminates; (2) Vehicle wraps and fleet graphics where graffiti vandalism requires expensive re-wrapping—Tedlar's chemical resistance allows spray paint and permanent marker removal without damaging underlying graphics; (3) Architectural graphics and building wraps requiring extreme weather performance—Tedlar's -70°F to 230°F operating range and mold/mildew resistance handles harsh climates that degrade competitor films; (4) Transit and rail interiors needing fire-rated, cleanable surfaces—Tedlar's proven transit heritage provides safety compliance and maintenance efficiency. These use cases directly benefit [Name]'s product strategy by filling the ultra-premium segment gap where Grimco currently lacks a scientifically-validated solution for customers demanding maximum performance and total cost of ownership advantages.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: [Name] is measured on portfolio profitability (gross margin dollars across product categories), market share growth in premium segments, customer satisfaction scores tied to product performance, and vendor partnership quality. Pain points this role personally owns: (1) Customer warranty claims and returns that erode distributor margins and damage relationships with fabricators; (2) Lost deals to competing distributors who offer differentiated premium products Grimco cannot match; (3) Price compression in commodity overlaminate categories forcing constant margin defense; (4) Vendor consolidation pressure as suppliers like 3M rationalize distribution partners. Tedlar addresses these through: premium pricing power that improves category margins, competitive differentiation that wins specification-driven projects, reduced returns from field failures due to superior durability, and a strategic partnership with DuPont that enhances Grimco's reputation as the premium supplier (reinforcing their 10-year FASTSIGNS Vendor of the Year status). [Name]'s career success depends on building a product mix that balances volume and profitability while maintaining Grimco's market leadership position.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: Grimco exhibited at Printing United 2023 and ISA 2024, demonstrating active market engagement and appetite for showcasing innovative products to their customer base. Their partnership with Canon at ISA 2024 to display new printing technology suggests they are currently focused on premium product positioning and technology leadership. The company's 10 consecutive FASTSIGNS Vendor of the Year awards (2015-2025) indicates they prioritize supplier partnerships that strengthen customer relationships—making this an opportune time to introduce a differentiation-enabling product. Additionally, with 65+ locations across North America and UK, Grimco likely conducts annual or bi-annual line reviews for national SKU additions, meaning H1 2025 could represent a portfolio planning window. The outdoor signage and vehicle wrap markets are experiencing growth in premium/ultra-durable segments as end-users demand lower total cost of ownership—creating pull-through demand that [Name] must address to maintain competitive position.

personalization_hooks.hook: Grimco's portfolio includes premium overlaminates from 3M, Avery Dennison, RTape, and Orafol, but these brands compete primarily on price and moderate outdoor durability—creating a gap in the ultra-premium segment for customers requiring validated 15-20 year outdoor performance
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Position Tedlar as the portfolio complement that enables Grimco to compete for specification-driven projects (architectural, municipal, transit) where current offerings don't meet performance requirements. Frame this as a margin expansion opportunity rather than a replacement for existing suppliers—Tedlar serves the 5-10% of customers willing to pay premium for extreme durability, graffiti resistance, and reduced maintenance

personalization_hooks.hook: As a 10-time consecutive FASTSIGNS Vendor of the Year winner, Grimco's reputation depends on offering products that help franchisees win business and avoid warranty issues—yet standard overlaminates cause field failures (UV degradation, graffiti damage, temperature extremes) that generate costly callbacks
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Lead with customer success framing: 'How do you help your sign shop customers avoid the warranty claims and re-installation costs that hurt their profitability?' Position Tedlar as the solution that protects Grimco's distributor relationships by solving end-user pain points, reinforcing their reputation as the supplier that prioritizes fabricator success over transaction volume

personalization_hooks.hook: Grimco showcased innovations at ISA 2024 and Printing United 2023, including partnerships with technology leaders like Canon, signaling they actively seek differentiated products that demonstrate market leadership and technical credibility
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Reference their trade show presence and innovation focus: 'I saw Grimco's ISA 2024 showcase with Canon—your emphasis on premium technology partnerships caught my attention.' Then position Tedlar as a natural fit for their innovation narrative, backed by DuPont's materials science heritage and 60+ years of field-validated performance data. Suggest exploring a co-marketing opportunity for future shows where Tedlar's extreme durability demonstrations could attract quality-focused fabricators to Grimco's booth

recommended_approach: Lead with the portfolio gap and margin opportunity angle. [Name] thinks strategically about product mix and competitive positioning, so open by acknowledging Grimco's strong relationships with current overlaminate suppliers while identifying the ultra-premium segment where those brands don't compete effectively. Position Tedlar as additive rather than disruptive—a specialized solution for the subset of customers (architectural graphics, municipal signage, transit applications) requiring extreme performance. Use the second email or follow-up to introduce the FASTSIGNS relationship protection angle with specific examples of how Tedlar prevents the field failures that damage distributor credibility. Request a brief exploratory call to understand their current portfolio priorities and share performance data relevant to their customer pain points.
